ValidationRule.description: All 5 department clearance flags must be completed before the case can advance past the Dept Clearance stage. Finance Cleared must be Cleared; all other flags must be checked.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISCHANGED(Status) && TEXT(PRIORVALUE(Status)) == 'Dept Clearance' && NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Dept Clearance') || ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Finance Review Incoming') || ISPICKVAL(Status, 'Draft')) && NOT(ASA_SA_Cleared__c && ISPICKVAL(Finance_Cleared__c, 'Cleared') && Operations_Cleared__c && IT_Cleared__c && LRC_Cleared__c)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: All department clearances must be completed before advancing past Dept Clearance stage. Please ensure all 5 clearance flags are set (ASA SA, Finance, Operations, IT, LRC).
